item.title: 📆 Top News Today Blacking out and disrupting logistics: Russian troops hit Ukrainian power infrastructure
item.description: 📆 Top News Today 👊 Blacking out and disrupting logistics: Russian troops hit Ukrainian power infrastructure facilities and ships used to support the AFU. 📍 FAB hits them dead bang: Russian Aerospace Forces destroyed rear infrastructure and enemy deployment areas close to Sumy and Dimitrovo in Zaporozhye region. 🎮 FPV raid on the enemy: the Yuzhnaya Group's drone operators of the 77th Separate Motorised Rifle Regiment hit a UAV control post and shelters near Druzhkovka. 💥 Rubikon designates, FABs obliterate : Rubikon Centre drone teams and Russian Aerospace Forces' crews wiped out enemy UAV control posts. ▫️ From basements to captivity: servicemen of the Tsentr Group's special operations unit told about performing tasks in Dnepropetrovsk direction. ⚓️ Onwards to new horizons: Russian Navy ships have completed business calls at the ports of the Republic of Seychelles and the Republic of Cameroon. This day was made by each and every one of us. We keep at it ! #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ From basements to captivity: Tsentr Group's special forces push militants out of their shelters
item.description: From basements to captivity: Tsentr Group's special forces push militants out of their shelters Servicemen of the Tsentr Group's special operations unit told about performing tasks in Dnepropetrovsk direction. ▫️ The servicemen conduct reconnaissance, reveal positions, UAV control posts, hardware and enemy manpower , then transmit the coordinates for fire damage. 🎮 Reconnaissance drone operators record all movements of militants and their hardware, while strike UAV teams promptly engage the targets , thwarting the enemy rotation and delivery of ammunition. 🎯 During the assault, the special forces clear settlements and streets, operating in small groups. Their combat work includes both fire damage and taking of prisoners: fighters get into close contact with the enemy in basements and shelters, keep the situation under control and ensure the evacuation of the surrendered. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30471

From basements to captivity: Tsentr Group's special forces push militants out of their shelters
Servicemen of the Tsentr Group's special operations unit told about performing tasks in Dnepropetrovsk direction.
▫️
The servicemen
conduct reconnaissance, reveal positions, UAV control posts, hardware and enemy manpower
, then transmit the coordinates for fire damage.
🎮
Reconnaissance drone operators
record all movements of militants and their hardware,
while strike UAV teams
promptly engage the targets
, thwarting the enemy rotation and delivery of ammunition.
🎯
During the assault, the special forces clear settlements and streets, operating in small groups.
Their combat work includes both fire damage and taking of prisoners:
fighters get into close contact with the enemy in basements and shelters, keep the situation under control and ensure the evacuation of the surrendered.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ⚓️ Onwards to new horizons! Russian Navy ships have completed business calls at the ports of the Republic of Seychelles and the Republic of Cameroon.
item.description: Onwards to new horizons! Russian Navy ships have completed business calls at the ports of the Republic of Seychelles and the Republic of Cameroon. ⚓️ The Pacific Fleet's frigate Marshal Shaposhnikov completed her stay programme in the port of Victoria, Republic of Seychelles , and went to sea. ▫️ The key event of the visit was the first Russian-Seychellois naval anti-piracy exercise. ➡️ At the same time, the Baltic Fleet's training ship Perekop, carrying out long-range navigation tasks since the beginning of July, completed her stay programme in the port of Douala, Republic of Cameroon. ▫️ Upon leaving port, the ship's crew practised joint manoeuvring elements with the Cameroon Navy patrol boat P-108. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30469
